name: Waves of Time knocks back on cast, not only two seconds later (#3729)
contract: Waves of Time 801277 reads "Blast enemies in a frontal cone with time fractals, knocking them back slightly. The knockback repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec." - two knockbacks, the first at cast time. Spell.dbc ships only the second: Effect[0] is Effect=183 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_TRIGGER_SPELL_DELAYED with EffectBasePoints 1999 / DieSides 1 (a 2000 ms delay), EffectTriggerSpell 802600 and EffectImplicitTargetA 1 (caster), and Spell::EffectAscensionTriggerSpellDelayed schedules exactly one delayed cast, so that effect is the "repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec" half and it already works. Effect[1] is Effect=64 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on EffectImplicitTargetA 24 (TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24) but its EffectTriggerSpell is 65633, Arcane Cast Visual - SpellFamilyName 3, one SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY, no handler and no script anywhere in src/ - so nothing whatsoever happens at cast time. The knockback itself is 802600: Effect=98 SPELL_EFFECT_KNOCK_BACK, EffectBasePoints 69, EffectMiscValue 150, EffectImplicitTargetA 24 with EffectRadiusIndex 13 = 10 yards in SpellRadius.dbc, which selects its own cone from the caster. The fix casts 802600 at cast time exactly as the delayed half does. Only timing discriminates: the assertions are bounded in time, because the target's total displacement after 2.5 seconds is the same with or without the fix. The dummy starts 3 yards in front of the caster and MotionMaster::MoveKnockbackFrom carries it 2 * (7 / 19.29) * 15 = 10.9 yards in about 0.73 s, which puts it past 802600's 10-yard cone radius; the second, delayed knockback therefore has no target left and is deliberately not asserted here. Unit::KnockbackFrom moves a creature server-side through MoveKnockbackFrom, while a player would only be sent SMSG_MOVE_KNOCK_BACK and would not move without a client acknowledgement, so the knocked-back actor has to be the creature.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The dummy starts inside the cone, three yards in front of the caster
Waves of Time, cone-targeted from the caster
The cone knocks the dummy back immediately, well before the two-second repeat
Let the first knockback's 0.73 s arc finish, still short of the 2 s repeat
The whole first knockback has landed before the delayed one could have fired
